title.zh: 给定逻辑公理，机器能不能自己找到定理的证明？
title.en: Given the axioms of logic, can a machine find proofs of theorems by itself?

summary.zh: Newell、Simon 和 Shaw 的程序为《数学原理》第二章前 52 条定理中的 38 条找到了证明，其中一条比原书的证明更简洁。
summary.en: Newell, Simon and Shaw's program proved 38 of the first 52 theorems in Chapter 2 of Principia Mathematica, one of them more elegantly than the book.

title.zh: 机器能不能证明平面几何题？
title.en: Can a machine prove plane-geometry theorems?

summary.zh: Gelernter 在 IBM 的几何定理证明程序用图形启发式剪枝搜索，证明了中学几何水平的定理。
summary.en: Gelernter's geometry prover at IBM used the diagram as a heuristic to prune search and proved high-school-level geometry theorems.

title.zh: 程序能不能通过自我对弈，学得比编写它的人下得更好？
title.en: Can a program learn, by playing itself, to play better than the person who wrote it?

summary.zh: Arthur Samuel 的西洋跳棋程序通过自我对弈调整评估函数，最终下得比 Samuel 本人更好。“机器学习”一词也由此流行。
summary.en: Arthur Samuel's checkers program tuned its evaluation function through self-play and came to outplay Samuel himself; it popularised the term "machine learning".

title.zh: 看着质谱数据，能不能推断出未知分子的结构？
title.en: From mass-spectrometry data, can a machine infer the structure of an unknown molecule?

summary.zh: 斯坦福的 DENDRAL 把化学家的知识写成规则，生成并筛选候选结构，是第一批真正处理专业领域问题的“专家系统”。
summary.en: Stanford's DENDRAL encoded chemists' knowledge as rules to generate and prune candidate structures — one of the first expert systems to tackle a real scientific task.

title.zh: 能不能根据症状和化验结果，判断血液感染的病菌并推荐抗生素？
title.en: Can a machine identify the bacteria behind a blood infection and recommend antibiotics?

summary.zh: 斯坦福的 MYCIN 用约 600 条规则进行诊断推理，在评估中给出的建议与感染科专家相当。
summary.en: Stanford's MYCIN reasoned with roughly 600 rules; in evaluations its recommendations compared well with infectious-disease specialists.

caveat.zh: 从未在临床中实际使用。
caveat.en: Never used in actual clinical practice.

title.zh: 程序能不能击败一项棋类游戏的世界冠军？
title.en: Can a program beat a reigning world champion at a board game?

summary.zh: Hans Berliner 的双陆棋程序 BKG 9.8 以 7:1 击败世界冠军 Luigi Villa，是程序首次击败棋类世界冠军。
summary.en: Hans Berliner's backgammon program BKG 9.8 beat world champion Luigi Villa 7–1 — the first time a program defeated a world champion at a board game.

caveat.zh: 双陆棋含掷骰运气成分，Berliner 本人也承认运气占了一部分。
caveat.en: Backgammon involves dice; Berliner acknowledged luck played a part.

title.zh: 机器能不能认出手写的邮政编码？
title.en: Can a machine read handwritten ZIP codes?

summary.zh: LeCun 等人用反向传播训练卷积神经网络识别手写数字，后来被用于美国邮政和银行支票的自动识别。
summary.en: LeCun et al. trained a convolutional network with backpropagation to read handwritten digits; the approach was later deployed to read mail and bank cheques.

title.zh: 不靠人教，只靠自己跟自己下，能下到顶尖人类水平吗？
title.en: Can a program reach top human level purely by playing against itself?

summary.zh: IBM 的 Tesauro 用时间差分强化学习训练神经网络下双陆棋，达到接近世界顶尖选手的水平，还改变了人类高手对某些开局的下法。
summary.en: IBM's Gerald Tesauro trained a neural network with temporal-difference learning to play backgammon near world-champion level; it even changed how experts played certain openings.

title.zh: 西洋跳棋的人机世界冠军会是谁？
title.en: Who would hold the man–machine world title in checkers?

summary.zh: 阿尔伯塔大学的 Chinook 成为第一个在人类锦标赛中赢得世界冠军头衔的程序。
summary.en: The University of Alberta's Chinook became the first program to win a human world-championship title.

caveat.zh: 对手 Tinsley 因病中途退赛，Chinook 由此获得头衔。
caveat.en: Opponent Marion Tinsley withdrew for health reasons mid-match.

title.zh: 所有 Robbins 代数都是布尔代数吗？（悬而未决 60 年的 Robbins 猜想）
title.en: Is every Robbins algebra Boolean? (the 60-year-old Robbins conjecture)

summary.zh: Argonne 实验室 McCune 的自动推理程序 EQP 找到了关键证明，结合已有成果解决了这个困扰数学家几十年的问题。
summary.en: William McCune's automated reasoning program EQP at Argonne found the key proof, settling — together with earlier results — a problem that had resisted mathematicians for decades.

title.zh: 计算机能不能在正式比赛中击败国际象棋世界冠军？
title.en: Can a computer beat the world chess champion in a match?

summary.zh: IBM 的深蓝以 3.5:2.5 击败卡斯帕罗夫，是计算机首次在标准赛制的对局中战胜在任世界冠军。
summary.en: IBM's Deep Blue beat Garry Kasparov 3½–2½, the first match victory by a computer over a reigning world champion under standard time controls.

title.zh: 航天器能不能在没有地面指挥的情况下，自己规划任务、自己处理故障？
title.en: Can a spacecraft plan its own operations and handle faults without ground control?

summary.zh: NASA 的 Remote Agent 在深空一号探测器上自主控制了几天，期间自行诊断并处理了模拟故障。
summary.en: NASA's Remote Agent autonomously controlled the Deep Space 1 probe for several days, diagnosing and handling simulated faults on its own.

title.zh: 无人车能不能自己穿越 200 多公里的沙漠？
title.en: Can a driverless car cross 200+ km of desert on its own?

summary.zh: 斯坦福的 Stanley 自动驾驶约 212 公里，赢得 DARPA 大挑战赛。一年前同一比赛中没有任何车辆跑完全程。
summary.en: Stanford's Stanley drove about 212 km autonomously to win the DARPA Grand Challenge; a year earlier no vehicle had finished.

title.zh: 西洋跳棋双方都下最优时，结局是什么？
title.en: What is the outcome of checkers under perfect play?

summary.zh: Schaeffer 团队经过 18 年计算证明：双方都不犯错时，西洋跳棋必然是和棋。
summary.en: After 18 years of computation, Schaeffer's team proved that checkers is a draw with perfect play by both sides.

title.zh: 机器能不能自己提出假设、设计实验、得出新的科学发现？
title.en: Can a machine form hypotheses, run experiments and make a new scientific discovery by itself?

summary.zh: “机器人科学家”Adam 自主提出并实验验证了酵母中若干“孤儿酶”对应的基因。
summary.en: The 'robot scientist' Adam autonomously hypothesised and experimentally confirmed genes encoding several orphan enzymes in yeast.

title.zh: 只给运动数据，机器能不能找出描述它的物理公式？
title.en: Given only motion data, can a machine find the physical law that describes it?

summary.zh: Schmidt 与 Lipson 用符号回归，从摆和振子的实验数据中重新找出了能量守恒等关系式。
summary.en: Schmidt and Lipson used symbolic regression to recover conservation laws such as energy from experimental data on pendulums and oscillators.

caveat.zh: 是从数据重新发现已知规律，不是发现新物理。
caveat.en: Rediscovery of known laws, not new physics.

title.zh: 机器能不能听懂充满双关和暗示的自然语言问题，并答得比人快、比人准？
title.en: Can a machine answer pun-laden natural-language questions faster and better than people?

summary.zh: IBM Watson 在美国问答节目《危险边缘》中击败两位历史最佳选手。
summary.en: IBM Watson defeated the two greatest human champions on the quiz show Jeopardy!.

title.zh: 机器能不能看懂上千类日常物体的照片？
title.en: Can a machine recognise photos across a thousand everyday object categories?

summary.zh: AlexNet 在 ImageNet 比赛中把 top-5 错误率降到约 15%，比第二名低 10 个百分点以上，从此深度学习成为主流。
summary.en: AlexNet cut ImageNet top-5 error to about 15%, more than 10 points ahead of the runner-up, launching the deep-learning era.

title.zh: 怎样设计实验，才能制备出复杂的高维量子纠缠态？
title.en: How do you design an experiment that produces complex high-dimensional entangled quantum states?

summary.zh: Krenn 等人的程序 MELVIN 自动搜索光学实验方案，找到了人类没有想到的设计，其中一些后来在实验室中实现。
summary.en: Krenn et al.'s program MELVIN automatically searched optical setups and found designs humans had not thought of; some were later built in the lab.

title.zh: 被认为还要十年才能被攻克的围棋，机器能下赢世界顶尖棋手吗？
title.en: Can a machine beat a top professional at Go, long thought a decade away?

summary.zh: DeepMind 的 AlphaGo 以 4:1 击败李世石。第 2 局的“第 37 手”让职业棋手重新思考围棋。
summary.en: DeepMind's AlphaGo beat Lee Sedol 4–1; its 'Move 37' in game 2 made professionals rethink the game.

title.zh: 量子多体系统的状态维数随粒子数指数增长，能不能更高效地表示和计算它？
title.en: Can quantum many-body states, whose size grows exponentially, be represented and computed more efficiently?

summary.zh: Carleo 与 Troyer 用神经网络表示波函数，在若干一维和二维自旋模型上算出了高精度的基态和动力学。
summary.en: Carleo and Troyer represented wavefunctions with neural networks and obtained high-accuracy ground states and dynamics for several 1D and 2D spin models.

caveat.zh: 只针对特定模型，不是一般量子多体问题的通解。
caveat.en: Specific models, not a general solution of the many-body problem.

title.zh: 看不到对手底牌、充满诈唬的扑克，机器能赢职业选手吗？
title.en: Can a machine beat professionals at poker, with hidden cards and bluffing?

summary.zh: 卡内基梅隆大学的 Libratus 在 12 万手一对一无限注德州扑克中大比分战胜四位顶尖职业选手。
summary.en: Carnegie Mellon's Libratus decisively beat four top professionals over 120,000 hands of heads-up no-limit Texas hold'em.

system: Google neural network + NASA Kepler data

title.zh: 已有的望远镜数据里，还藏着没被发现的行星吗？
title.en: Are there undiscovered planets hiding in existing telescope data?

summary.zh: 神经网络在开普勒望远镜的数据中找出了此前漏检的行星 Kepler-90i，使 Kepler-90 成为已知行星数与太阳系并列最多（8 颗）的恒星系统。
summary.en: A neural network found the previously missed planet Kepler-90i in Kepler data, making Kepler-90 the first system known to tie our Solar System with eight planets.

title.zh: 只知道规则、完全不看人类棋谱，能不能从零学会国际象棋、将棋和围棋？
title.en: Knowing only the rules and no human games, can a machine master chess, shogi and Go from scratch?

summary.zh: AlphaZero 只靠自我对弈，在三种棋类上都击败了当时最强的专用程序。
summary.en: Through self-play alone, AlphaZero defeated the strongest specialised programs in all three games.

title.zh: 六人同桌的多人扑克，机器也能赢吗？
title.en: Can a machine win at six-player poker?

summary.zh: Pluribus 在六人无限注德州扑克中战胜精英职业选手，是 AI 首次在主要的多人博弈中超越顶尖人类。
summary.en: Pluribus beat elite professionals at six-player no-limit hold'em, the first superhuman result in a major multiplayer game.

title.zh: 能不能在已有化合物中，找到结构全新的抗生素候选？
title.en: Can we find structurally novel antibiotic candidates among existing compounds?

summary.zh: MIT 团队用深度学习筛选了上亿个分子，找到 halicin，它在实验室和小鼠实验中对多种耐药菌有效。
summary.en: An MIT team used deep learning to screen over 100 million molecules and identified halicin, which killed many drug-resistant bacteria in the lab and in mice.

caveat.zh: 候选药物，尚未获批用于临床。
caveat.en: A drug candidate, not an approved medicine.

title.zh: 只知道氨基酸序列，能不能准确预测蛋白质的三维结构？（困扰生物学 50 年的“蛋白质折叠问题”）
title.en: From its amino-acid sequence alone, can we predict a protein's 3D structure? (the 50-year protein-folding problem)

summary.zh: AlphaFold 2 在 CASP14 竞赛中的预测精度达到接近实验测定的水平，后来又公开了超过 2 亿个蛋白质的预测结构。
summary.en: At CASP14, AlphaFold 2 reached accuracy competitive with experimental methods; predicted structures for over 200 million proteins were later released.

caveat.zh: 解决的是结构预测，蛋白质如何动态折叠、如何相互作用等问题仍在研究中。
caveat.en: Solves structure prediction; folding dynamics and interactions remain open research.

title.zh: 能不能自动构造反例，推翻图论和组合数学中的猜想？
title.en: Can a machine construct counterexamples that refute conjectures in graph theory and combinatorics?

summary.zh: Adam Zsolt Wagner 用强化学习构造图和矩阵，找到了若干已发表猜想的反例。
summary.en: Adam Zsolt Wagner used reinforcement learning to construct graphs and matrices, finding counterexamples to several published conjectures.

title.zh: 纽结的几何性质和代数性质之间，有没有尚未发现的联系？
title.en: Are there undiscovered links between the geometric and algebraic invariants of knots?

summary.zh: 机器学习帮助数学家发现了纽结理论中的新关系，也为表示论中的一个猜想提供了线索，数学家随后完成了严格证明。
summary.en: Machine learning pointed mathematicians to a new relation in knot theory and progress on a representation-theory conjecture, which they then proved rigorously.

title.zh: 怎样协调几十个线圈，控制托卡马克里高温等离子体的形状？
title.en: How do you coordinate dozens of coils to shape hot plasma inside a tokamak?

summary.zh: 强化学习控制器在瑞士 TCV 托卡马克的真实装置上，成功控制出多种等离子体构型。
summary.en: A reinforcement-learning controller shaped a variety of plasma configurations on the real TCV tokamak in Switzerland.

title.zh: 矩阵乘法还能更快吗？
title.en: Can matrix multiplication be done with fewer operations?

summary.zh: AlphaTensor 找到了 4×4 矩阵在模 2 运算下只需 47 次乘法的算法，打破了 Strassen 方法 50 多年来的纪录。
summary.en: AlphaTensor found an algorithm for 4×4 matrices over arithmetic mod 2 using 47 multiplications, beating Strassen's 50-year-old record in that setting.

caveat.zh: 这一改进只在模 2 运算下成立。
caveat.en: This improvement holds only for arithmetic mod 2.

title.zh: 针对世卫组织列为最危险级别的鲍曼不动杆菌，能找到新的抗生素候选吗？
title.en: Can we find a new antibiotic against Acinetobacter baumannii, a WHO critical-priority pathogen?

summary.zh: 研究者用深度学习找到 abaucin，它对鲍曼不动杆菌的作用范围很窄，在小鼠伤口感染模型中有效。
summary.en: Researchers used deep learning to identify abaucin, a narrow-spectrum compound active against A. baumannii in a mouse wound model.

caveat.zh: 候选药物，尚未获批用于临床。
caveat.en: A drug candidate, not an approved medicine.

title.zh: 被优化了几十年的基础排序代码，还能更快吗？
title.en: Can decades-optimised basic sorting routines get any faster?

summary.zh: AlphaDev 找到了更快的短序列排序汇编程序，已被合并进 LLVM 的 C++ 标准库。
summary.en: AlphaDev discovered faster assembly routines for sorting short sequences; they were merged into LLVM's C++ standard library.

title.zh: 能不能用火星陨石成分，找到能从水中制氧的催化剂配方？
title.en: Can we find an oxygen-producing catalyst made from Martian meteorite materials?

summary.zh: 中国科学技术大学的机器人 AI 化学家在数百万种可能配方中自动合成、测试并优化，找到了有效的析氧催化剂。
summary.en: USTC's robotic AI chemist automatically synthesised, tested and optimised candidates from millions of possible recipes, finding an effective oxygen-evolution catalyst.

caveat.zh: 实验在地面实验室完成，并非已经在火星上制氧。
caveat.en: Done in an Earth lab, not on Mars.

title.zh: AI 能不能比传统数值天气预报预测得更准？
title.en: Can AI forecast the weather better than traditional numerical models?

summary.zh: GraphCast 的 10 天全球天气预报在约 90% 的评测指标上优于欧洲中期天气预报中心的高精度业务系统，单台机器不到一分钟就能算完。
summary.en: GraphCast's 10-day global forecasts beat ECMWF's high-resolution operational system on about 90% of verification targets, running in under a minute on one machine.

title.zh: 还有多少稳定的无机晶体材料没有被发现？
title.en: How many stable inorganic crystals remain undiscovered?

summary.zh: GNoME 预测了 220 万种新晶体，其中约 38 万种被认为是稳定的；同期的自动化实验室合成出了其中一部分。
summary.en: GNoME predicted 2.2 million new crystals, about 380,000 of them deemed stable; an autonomous lab synthesised some of them.

caveat.zh: “新材料”的数量和新颖性受到部分材料学家质疑。
caveat.en: Some materials scientists have questioned the count and novelty of the 'new materials'.

title.zh: 有限几何中“没有三点共线”的点集（cap set），最大能构造到多大？
title.en: How large can a cap set — a set with no three points on a line — be made?

summary.zh: FunSearch 让大语言模型写程序、自动评估并迭代，在 8 维中找到了比已知更大的 cap set，并改进了相关的渐近下界。
summary.en: FunSearch had an LLM write programs that were automatically scored and evolved, finding larger cap sets in dimension 8 and improving an asymptotic lower bound.

caveat.zh: 改进的是下界和具体构造，不是确定了最大值。
caveat.en: Improves constructions and lower bounds; the maximum is not determined.

title.zh: 奥数几何题需要的辅助线，机器能自己想到吗？
title.en: Can a machine come up with the auxiliary constructions olympiad geometry needs?

summary.zh: AlphaGeometry 在 30 道国际奥数几何题中解出 25 道，接近金牌选手的平均水平。
summary.en: AlphaGeometry solved 25 of 30 olympiad geometry problems, approaching the average IMO gold medallist.

title.zh: AI 能不能在国际数学奥林匹克竞赛的全部题型上拿到奖牌？
title.en: Can AI earn a medal across a full International Mathematical Olympiad?

summary.zh: DeepMind 的系统解出 2024 年 IMO 六题中的四题，达到银牌水平，证明以 Lean 形式化语言写成。
summary.en: DeepMind's systems solved 4 of 6 IMO 2024 problems — silver-medal standard — with proofs written in the Lean formal language.

caveat.zh: 题目先由人工翻译成形式化语言，部分题目的计算时间远超比赛时限。
caveat.en: Problems were manually formalised; some took far longer than contest time.

title.zh: AI 预测蛋白质结构的工作，算不算得上诺贝尔奖级别的科学贡献？
title.en: Does AI protein-structure work count as Nobel-level science?

summary.zh: 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖一半授予 Hassabis 与 Jumper（AlphaFold），另一半授予 David Baker（计算蛋白质设计）。
summary.en: The 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry went half to Hassabis and Jumper (AlphaFold) and half to David Baker (computational protein design).

title.zh: 两个 4×4 复数矩阵相乘，能不能少做一次乘法？11 维空间里一个球周围最多能贴多少个球？
title.en: Can two 4×4 complex matrices be multiplied with one fewer multiplication? How many spheres can touch one sphere in 11 dimensions?

summary.zh: AlphaEvolve 找到了 48 次标量乘法的 4×4 复矩阵乘法算法（此前为 49 次），还找到了 11 维中 593 个球的接触构型，把已知下界提高了。
summary.en: AlphaEvolve found a 48-multiplication algorithm for 4×4 complex matrices (previously 49) and a 593-sphere kissing configuration in 11 dimensions, raising the known lower bound.

caveat.zh: 593 是“至少能放这么多”，不是证明了最大值。
caveat.en: 593 is a lower bound, not the proven maximum.

system: Gemini Deep Think; OpenAI experimental model

title.zh: 只用自然语言、在比赛时限内，AI 能拿到国际数学奥林匹克金牌吗？
title.en: Working in natural language within contest time, can AI reach IMO gold?

summary.zh: Google DeepMind 的 Gemini Deep Think（成绩经 IMO 官方评分）和 OpenAI 的实验模型都宣布解出 2025 年 IMO 六题中的五题，达到金牌分数线。
summary.en: Google DeepMind's Gemini Deep Think (officially graded by the IMO) and an OpenAI experimental model both reported solving 5 of 6 IMO 2025 problems, a gold-medal score.

caveat.zh: 竞赛题是已有答案的题目，不等于解决开放问题。
caveat.en: Competition problems have known answers; not the same as open research problems.

title.zh: 颗粒堵塞理论中，为什么两个临界指数满足 a + b = 1？
title.en: In the theory of jamming, why do two critical exponents satisfy a + b = 1?

summary.zh: 这个关系早有高精度数值支持，却一直缺少解析证明。诺贝尔奖得主 Parisi 与 Zamponi 等人在与 Claude 的交互中得到并核查了证明。
summary.en: The relation had strong numerical support but no analytic proof. Nobel laureate Giorgio Parisi, Francesco Zamponi and colleagues obtained and checked a proof while working with Claude.

caveat.zh: 结论在无限维硬球的 fullRSB 理论框架内成立。
caveat.en: Holds within the infinite-dimensional hard-sphere fullRSB framework.

title.zh: 黎曼ζ函数的非平凡零点，能证明至少有多大比例落在临界线上？
title.en: What fraction of the Riemann zeta function's nontrivial zeros can be proven to lie on the critical line?

summary.zh: Anthropic 称，Claude 的研究版本把已知下界从 41.6% 提高到 67.2%，同时公开了论文、专家意见和 Lean 形式化证明。
summary.en: Anthropic reports that a research version of Claude raised the known lower bound from 41.6% to 67.2%, releasing the paper, expert notes and a Lean formalization.

caveat.zh: 黎曼猜想本身没有被证明，这是攻关过程中顺带得到的结果。
caveat.en: The Riemann hypothesis itself remains unproven; this was a byproduct of the attempt.

system: OpenAI internal model (GPT-6 Astra for Lean)

title.zh: 一开始光滑的三维流体，会不会在有限时间内出现奇点？（Navier–Stokes 千禧年难题）
title.en: Can a smooth 3D fluid develop a singularity in finite time? (the Navier–Stokes Millennium Problem)

summary.zh: OpenAI 称其内部模型证明了：在施加光滑外力的情况下，Navier–Stokes 方程的解会在有限时间内爆破，并公开了 Lean 形式化证明；同时还给出了无外力 Euler 方程的爆破结果。
summary.en: OpenAI says its internal model proved finite-time blowup for Navier–Stokes with a smooth external force, releasing a Lean formalization, plus a blowup result for the unforced Euler equations.

caveat.zh: 这是发布方的主张，尚未经同行评审，也未获克雷研究所认定。Buckmaster 与 Alpöge 同期发表了相关的爆破结果，双方存在归属争议。
caveat.en: Publisher's claim; not yet peer reviewed or recognised by the Clay Institute. Buckmaster and Alpöge posted related blowup results concurrently, with a dispute over credit.

title.zh: 一个 AI 模型能同时在多少个数学问题上取得新结果？
title.en: How many mathematical problems can one AI model produce new results on at once?

summary.zh: OpenAI 一次性公开了一批由内部模型得到的新数学结果，平均每个结果约用 3 小时推理，其中许多附有 Lean 形式化证明。
summary.en: OpenAI released a large batch of new mathematical results from an internal model — about three hours of reasoning each on average — many with Lean formalizations.

caveat.zh: 各结果的验证程度不同，需要逐题拆分查看。
caveat.en: Verification varies by result; each needs to be examined individually.
